details: The pointerenter handler starts 200ms transitions on bars, labels, and edges without calling .interrupt() first, so rapid hover between tasks leaves prior transitions mid-flight and causes visual snapping; pointerleave correctly calls .interrupt() but pointerenter does not. All other checks pass: pointermove only moves the tooltip (no DOM mutation storm), there is no cross-view dispatch capable of looping, xScale/yScale are static so no stale closure risk, and the unified Pointer Events API (pointerenter/pointermove/pointerleave) avoids any mouse-touch double-trigger.
